name: Tunguska Event
description: A large atmospheric explosion over the Podkamennaya Tunguska River, Siberia, on 30 June 1908 — the largest impact event in recorded history, now widely attributed to the airburst of a small asteroid 5–10 km above the surface.
origin: Localized event with effects concentrated in central Siberia, but atmospheric and luminous effects observed across Eurasia.
